Gible

Dragon Ground

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Gible is a Dragon/Ground-type Land Shark Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 20.5 kg. It evolves into Gabite. Its highest base stat is Attack (70), with a base stat total of 300.
